blake-poetical-works.case: Bloom lists Blake's complete poetry and prose; we hold only the Songs. Sampson's Oxford text is the scholarly standard; Ellis's two volumes add the major prophetic books (Milton, Jerusalem, Four Zoas) that Sampson's 1913 volume prints only in part.
blake-poetical-works.note: Ellis's text is heavily emended and was criticised in its day; take Sampson as the reading text and Ellis for the major prophecies. Keynes's 1925 Nonesuch 'Writings' would be the true complete edition but was not checked. Prose (Marriage of Heaven and Hell) is also PG 45315.
